camera_rig.route: Rapid tracking shots, snappy whip-pans, and stabilizing push-ins.

sonic_blueprint.room_acoustics: Wet, reverberant London street exterior transitioning sharply into hyper-clean, acoustically dampened luxury retail interior.

master_bgm.genre_style: Syncopated UK Garage / Hyper-Pop Runway Sizzle
instrumentation: Syncopated 2-step drum groove with punchy kick and crisp rimshots
Glittering hyper-pop synth arpeggios and vocal chops
Dramatic snare roll risers and white-noise sweeps

stems.percussion: Rhythmic pulse and transient acoustic hits
stems.harmony: Mid-range chord progression and ambient pads
stems.lead: Hero melodic motif or lead arpeggio

master_bgm.dynamic_arc: Seconds 00-08: Snappy 2-step rhythm kicks in on the wink. Seconds 08-16: Heavy bassline drops inside flagship. Seconds 16-24: Massive riser sweep building energy. Seconds 24-32: Sudden cut to dead silence on final freeze-frame bag snap, leaving only a sub-bass decay.
master_bgm.lyria_prompt: High-energy UK Garage fashion runway track, 138 BPM, F Minor. Syncopated skipping 2-step beats, punchy kick drum, driving Moog bassline, glittering hyper-pop synth arpeggios, and edgy vocal chops. Builds rapidly with dramatic snare roll risers into an explosive, sleek high-fashion drop, ending abruptly on a crisp impact hit.

slides.narrative_copy: Extreme vertical macro close-up on Model Maya's eye with shimmering holographic eyeshadow in Soho rain. -> Maya executes a sharp, deliberate runway wink directly into lens at second 02. -> On the wink, camera whip-pans 90 degrees right to reveal a rain-slicked Soho street with a motion-blurred red double-decker bus streaking past. Kinetic Chain: Micro-eye movement -> High-velocity eyelid closure (wink) -> Triggered camera whip-pan acceleration -> Rapid rotational deceleration -> Wet asphalt perspective stabilization.

slides.headline: SC02: The Flagship Infiltration: Tactile Glamour
slides.narrative_copy: Camera pushes forward through glowing glass sliding doors into the hyper-bright SEPHORA flagship. -> Model Kaelen slides a metallic gold lipstick casing open, revealing a vibrant crimson bullet. -> A large soft makeup brush sweeps across Maya's cheekbone in a rapid beauty montage, dusting fine shimmering particles. Kinetic Chain: Door glide -> Hand grips weighted lipstick tube -> Thumb drives cap removal with magnetic click -> Brush fibers compress against cheek skin -> Shimmer cloud dispersion.

slides.headline: SC03: The Soho Runway Strut
slides.narrative_copy: Maya and Kaelen strut in synchronized lockstep out of the store entrance onto the wet London sidewalk. -> Maya's stiletto heels plant firmly onto the wet pavement with zero slip or float. -> Maya swings the iconic black-and-white SEPHORA shopping bag forward in an assertive arc toward camera. Kinetic Chain: Stiletto strike on wet cobblestone -> Ground reaction force pushes hip forward -> Arm swings bag from shoulder -> Centrifugal arc of braided handle -> Forward presentation.

slides.headline: SC04: The Bag Lock & The Soho Freeze
slides.narrative_copy: The camera punches in 60 centimeters directly toward the SEPHORA shopping bag held firmly in Maya's hand. -> The bag halts dead-center in the vertical frame, perfectly upright with sharp paper edges. -> At second 30, the video cuts to a crisp editorial freeze-frame on the bag and SEPHORA logo, with blurred glowing Soho neon behind. Kinetic Chain: Punch-in camera motion -> Arm locks bag at chest height -> Rope handles tension under gravity -> Abrupt momentum cessation -> Total frozen frame.
